column1: # DECLARED anchors for the lap livery (tools/art/make_livery.py reads this; nothing is searched for or inferred).
# Written at the desk by looking at the twelve base pictures, enlarged. Planes face RIGHT. Pixel coordinates, (0,0) = top-left.
#   gx gy  = the centre of the globe, gr = its radius (portrait 4..7; a sprite's globe is the fixed 3x3 glyph, so gr is 1)
#   sx0..sx1 = the stripe's columns, sy0..sy1 = its rows (inclusive); only pixels that are light enough (the dark outline and the windows stay) are painted gold

# The script FAILS if any globe pixel or any declared stripe cell is not a drawn pixel of the plane's body, if too few stripe cells take the gold, or if a picture goes over its budget (14 sprite, 500 portrait).

# Hydrogen: the blended wing's own fin is about 12 px wide, so its globe sits on the aft body just in front of it. Twin: the stripe is on the white part only (the gold cheat line and the gold door bar are already gold).
